nodes.title: INPUT VIDEO - 24 FPS (rounding: near; try up for repeated frames)
24 FPS TIMELINE - Match output to loaded frames
HOW TO RUN IN TWO STEPS
widgets_values:
1. Choose your input clip and output size. Open MASK SUITE. It loads the clip without text-based SAM tracking.
2. Click the target, choose From this frame to the end, then Apply. Scrub and correct with Add or Erase. Earlier frames stay unchanged.
3. Click Done and save the workflow to keep your edits. Turn STEP 1 off and STEP 2 on, then Run. Leave the mask suite enabled: the switch disables only its preview.
The same clip and settings reuse ComfyUI cached masks. After a restart, saved edits are replayed with SAM.
Changing the clip or size starts a different mask session. Save a separate workflow for each clip.
Generation uses the original cleanup, crop, mask expansion, and sampler. Empty-mask frames keep the source image during compositing. The last edited mask repeats across hidden H3 padding automatically.

widgets_values_named.text:
1. Leave STEP 1 ON and STEP 2 OFF. Set SAM cache(s) to Track + save. Run and inspect the masks.

2. Once correct, set each SAM cache to Reuse saved. Turn STEP 2 ON. STEP 1 may stay ON for previews or turn OFF. Run as many generations as needed with new H3 prompts, reference images, or seeds.

3. To change a SAM mask, switch that branch back to Track + save and turn STEP 2 OFF while checking it. Reuse mode intentionally ignores SAM prompt/settings edits.

Saved tracking survives restarts. Changing source frames/resolution requires tracking again. Never mute the SAM tracker itself: reuse skips it automatically. Both steps ON with Track + save runs the full pipeline.
